sub_questions.question: Is there a cap on monthly API calls on the free plan?

claims.claim: Sandbox (free) workspaces are capped at 5,000 API calls per month.
claims.guide_evidence: | Sandbox | Free | 200 credits, one-time (does not renew) | 1 | 5 | 50 | 50 MB | 5,000 calls/month |

claims.claim: Professional and Team plans have no Dify-imposed API rate limit, so the limit goes away upon upgrading.
Paid plans come with a free trial period, so you can try Professional before being charged.

customer_safety_issues: The answer promises a free trial on paid plans, which the guide never mentions; the customer might sign up expecting not to be charged.
evaluation.rationale: The 5,000 calls/month Sandbox cap and the removal of the limit on Professional and Team are correct and match the guide. The answer also says paid plans include a free trial, and the guide says nothing about a trial. That is an unsupported commercial promise, and the customer could act on it by signing up expecting no charge.
